products.tg: EDGE PROFILE FOR CONTAINMENT AND SEGMENTING OF LANDSCAPE FEATURES
products.pk: SikaRoof VersiEdge P 150 Refer to pricelist

ev.t: SikaRoof VersiEdge P is a high strength edge profile designed to retain and frame vegetated roof gardens. The edge profile is manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and is used to separate planting media and aggregates from other materials in the rooftop area. SikaRoof VersiEdge P has a L-shaped design to utilise the weight of the green roof build-up to keep the barrier in place allowing the zoning of different elements in rooftop gardens.
Edge profile and aggregate partition for landscape roofs.
Partition and edge profile for landscape roofs
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range

products.tg: JOINER FOR WALL EXTENDER FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOF PLANTING TRAY
products.pk: SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Joiner Refer to pricelist

ev.t: SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Joiner is a joiner for wall extenders designed to allow wall extenders to be joined side to side, creating a single perimeter wall around the extensive green roof plot. Wall extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and slot into two adjacent wall extenders to connect them. SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Joiner is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Extender and SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 trays to increase the soil capacity of these trays enabling more diverse planting options.

Increased planting media capacity for extensive green roofs, landscape decks and lightweight green installations requiring water storage in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the reservoir and drainage layer.

ev.t: SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Extender is a wall extender designed to increase the wall height of an extensive green roof planting tray to increase the soil capacity of each tray. Wall extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and slot into the trays connecting at 90º angles to each wall extender. SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiDrain BG, SikaRoof VersiDrain MEP and SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 trays to increase the soil capacity of these trays enabling more diverse planting options.
